verdicts.reason: A turns the original into a sensible vertical stack: the can sits on its circle, then wordmark, headline, copy, badges and CTA share one left edge with a clear hierarchy. Its flaws are minor: the lower block is cramped, with tight gaps between copy, badges and CTA and a thin bottom margin, while the circle nearly touches the canvas sides. B has the same text layout, but the green circle has come loose from the can and sits in the lower-left corner behind the body copy, badges and CTA. That is an unwanted collision behind text, and the can is left floating without its backdrop.
